Getting started

The theme folder

Everything a theme has is in its folder, found by its path from it.

themes/
  theme.schema.json      the schema of theme.json, for your editor (the app writes it)
  rp.d.ts                the types of rp, for scripts (the app writes it)
  my-theme/
    theme.json           what the theme is and what it changes (needed)
    theme.css            its CSS (optional; more files with "styles")
    preview.webp         its picture in the list of themes, 16:9
    systems.json         what each system has of its own (put in by "include")
    fonts/  images/  sounds/  videos/  systems/
    effects/stars.html   a page of scripts drawn as a layer
    pages/home.html      a page of scripts placed in a scene
  • Paths use / and start from the theme folder: "images/bg.webp". In CSS, url(images/bg.webp) starts from the CSS file’s folder.
  • Names must match exactly, capitals too: Logo.PNG is not logo.png.
  • A theme uses only its own files: no address of the network, no file elsewhere on the computer. It works offline, and it can’t track anyone.
  • Pictures: png, jpg, webp, avif, gif, svg. Fonts: woff2, woff, ttf, otf. Sounds: ogg, mp3, wav, flac, m4a. Videos: mp4, webm.

Sharing a theme

Each theme in the list has Export .zip; Import .zip adds one to your themes (its theme.json at the top of the zip, or in one folder). Nothing in a zip is ever written outside the new theme’s folder.
